svg.text: Ch'alish P'ilam, the common hand — layer 3: the font
A night's entry at the sighting stones, as the Faith of Ish'ilan Ch'alish keeps one every night whether or not anything happens. A record of meaning, not of words.
Shaped by HarfBuzz through fonts/ChalishPilamCommon-Regular.ttf and drawn from its outlines. Each column is two advances wide and wraps by line breaking alone; nothing in the sheet places the rows.
The entry at display size, each glyph's concept under it; read two to a row, down each column
The page at 32, 24 and 16 px to the em
Inline: a run of the script inside a line of Latin, both at 32 px
